title: Fractional CMO for Trade Businesses | Vestis Solutions
description: A fractional CMO for owner-led businesses without a marketing department. Get found on Google, Maps and AI answers, with a website built to bring in work.
h1: A fractional CMO for businesses without a marketing department
intro: You know you should be showing up on Google, but nobody owns it. The website is old, the agency sends reports you don't read, and the good jobs go to the competitor who ranks higher. A fractional CMO gives you one person who owns getting found, without hiring a marketing team.
definition: A fractional CMO is a part-time chief marketing officer who sets a company's marketing direction and owns the results, a few hours a month. For a small business, that usually means getting found online, a website that turns visitors into calls, and a clear plan for where marketing money goes.

sections.h2: What a fractional CMO does for an owner-led business
paras: Big-company CMOs manage brand teams and large budgets. You need something simpler: when a homeowner or property manager searches for what you do, your business shows up, looks trustworthy, and gets the call.
That's the job I take on.
bullets: SEO for Google search and Google Maps, so you show up in your service area
AEO (answer engine optimization), so ChatGPT and Gemini mention you when people ask
A website built or rebuilt to be found and to turn visitors into calls
Ongoing monthly work on your site, your Google profile and your AI visibility
Optional paid ads: Google Local Services, Google Ads or social ads

sections.h2: Getting found now includes AI answers
paras: More people now ask ChatGPT or Gemini who to call instead of scrolling through search results. Those tools pull from websites that answer questions clearly and from businesses with consistent, trustworthy information across the web.
AEO is the work of making your business one of the answers. It builds on solid SEO, so I run the two together.

sections.h2: Marketing only works if sales can keep up
paras: Turning up lead flow on a broken process only brings more stress. So I also review how leads are handled, from first contact to signed job, and fix where they leak. That way the leads marketing brings in actually turn into work.
Paid ads are optional and extra. If they make sense, you pay the ad budget directly to Google or Meta, and management is quoted separately. Many owners start with SEO and AEO alone.

sections.h2: How it works and what it costs
paras: Partnerships start at $3,000 a month. We begin with 90 days, then continue month to month. You get four 30-minute owner sessions a month and up to 12 delivery hours. I'm based in Charlotte, NC, and work with businesses across the US. It starts with a free 30-minute fit call.

signs: Nobody in your business owns marketing
Competitors show up on Google Maps and you don't
Your website is old, slow or hard to update
You pay an agency but can't tell what it's doing
You've never checked what ChatGPT says about your business

faq.q: What does a fractional CMO do?
faq.a: A fractional CMO sets your marketing direction and owns the results, part time. For a small trade or service business, that means getting found on Google, Maps and AI answers, a website that brings in calls, and deciding where marketing money goes. You get one accountable person instead of a team you'd need to manage.

faq.q: How much does a fractional CMO cost?
faq.a: Fractional CMO costs vary a lot by scope and hours. My partnerships start at $3,000 a month, covering a website build or rebuild, ongoing SEO and AEO, a sales process review and four owner sessions. Ad spend is separate and paid by you directly, so you always see where that money goes.

faq.q: Is a fractional CMO better than a marketing agency?
faq.a: A fractional CMO is better when you need someone to own strategy and results, not only run tasks. An agency usually sells a set service. A fractional CMO looks at the whole picture, including whether your sales process can handle more leads, and tells you plainly what to do first.

AEO stands for answer engine optimization: making your business show up in AI answers from tools like ChatGPT and Gemini. It relies on a website that answers real questions clearly and on consistent business information across the web. It works best on top of solid SEO.

faq.q: Do I need to run paid ads?
faq.a: No, paid ads are optional. Many owner-led businesses get good results from SEO, a strong Google profile and a website that converts. If ads make sense later, you pay the ad budget directly, management is quoted separately, and nothing is spent without your approval.

faq.q: When should a small business hire a fractional CMO?
faq.a: Hire one when marketing matters to growth but nobody owns it. Common signs are an outdated website, weak Google Maps visibility, or an agency whose results you can't explain. If you're not ready for a full-time marketing hire, a fractional CMO fills that gap.
